xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on October 22, 2026.
2.The statutory auditors of the Parent company have expressed an unmodified opinion on the unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
3.The unaudited consolidaterd financial results of the Company have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) notified under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Indian Accounting Standard Rules), 2015, as amended. The above statement of consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 are drawn up in accordance with the requirements of Regulation 33 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended from time to time.
4. The company has two wholly owned subsidiaries incorporated in India, first being M/s. Bansal Steel & Power Limited and another being M/s. BWI Steel Private Limited. The management has exercised the necessary diligence to ensure that the standalone financial results of the respective companies for the relevant periods provide a true and fair view of their affairs.
5. The Statement includes the results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 being the balancing figure between the unaudited figures for the half year ended September 30, 2026 and September 30, 2025 and and the published unaudited figures for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 and June 30, 2025 of the respective financial year, prepared in accordance with the recognition and measurement principles laid down in Indian Accounting Standard 34 “Interim Financial Reporting”.
6. The Board of Directors of Company in their meeting held on August 12, 2026 have approved the sub division/ split of each equity share of face value of Rs 5/- each fully paid in to 5 equity share having face value of Rs 1/- fully paid each.
The shareholder approved the sub division in Annual General Meeting (AGM) held as on September 17, 2026 and October 16, 2026, was fixed as the record date. Accordingly, the impact of sub division/ split has been considered in the computation of basic and diluted earning per share (EPS) for quarter and half year ended september 30, 2026 and comparative prior period figure have been restated retrospectively to give effect of sub division/ split in accordance with requirement of Ind AS 33- Earnings per share.
7. The group is engaged primarily in the business of manufacturing of steel wire and, as such, does not have any separate reportable segments in accordance with Ind AS 108 - Operating Segments.
8. The consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 are available on the Company's website at www.bansalwire.com and also on the website of BSE Limited at www.bseindia.com and National Stock Exchange of India Limited at www.nseindia.com, where the shares of the Company are listed.
9. Figures for the periods/year are reclassified, regrouped wherever necessary to confirm to current period presentation.
